Three reasons owners do not delegate, and a small fix for each.

1. "Explaining takes longer than doing it."
Write the task once as a 5-line brief. Reuse it every time.

2. "It will come back wrong."
Ask who checks the work before you see it. Choose a service with a review step.

3. "I will lose control."
Give access to one tool and one task for one week. Widen it later.

Which of the three has stopped you?

#Delegation #SmallBusiness

A low hourly rate is not always the low cost.

Effective rate = hourly rate divided by the share of the work you can use as delivered.

$4 an hour, and one task in three needs redoing: $4 / 0.67 = $6 per useful hour.
$6 an hour with a review step: $6 per useful hour.

Same cost. One of them also costs you the time to find the errors.

How do you measure the quality of outsourced work?

#Outsourcing #SmallBusiness
x: Effective rate = hourly rate / share of work you can use. $4 an hour with 1 task in 3 redone = $6 per useful hour. A $6 rate with review = $6. Same cost, fewer surprises.
